posts.title: Forty-Eight Thirty-Six
posts.author: Commissioner
body: **Mexican Mafia 48.36.** That is the lowest score anybody has posted in 2026, by more than eleven points, and it took a starting nine to do it. Drake Maye gave Alberto Ruiz **4.76** at quarterback. De'Von Achane and Tetairoa McMillan both went for **1.70**. The Rams defense chipped in **3.00**. Silver Stars won it **126.56 to 48.36** behind Jahmyr Gibbs' **34.40** and never had to think about it. The Mafia own two of the five highest-scoring games in league history, both from 2025, and now this.

Dirty South got off the mat, **137.68 over Sponge Bobs, 105.18**. Joe Burrow went **26.58**, James Cook **20.40**, Jaylen Warren **17.60**, Harold Fannin **17.10**, and the Minnesota defense added **17.00** — five starters in double figures and no holes. Ron Wasilewski got **35.28** out of Brock Purdy and lost by **32.50** anyway, which is impressive work. Sam Darnold put up **31.66** on his bench. That would have left him **0.84** short, so it does not even qualify as a decision. Wasilewski entered this season **173-172-6**, a lifetime winning record by exactly one game. He is now **173-175-6**.

The best game of the week was the one nobody will talk about. **BIG Kahunas 110.72, Brendawg21 106.50** — a margin of **4.22**. Bijan Robinson went for **33.30** and Spencer Shrader kicked **17.00**, which is a sentence that should embarrass somebody. Brendan Ryan got **25.36** from Jaxon Smith-Njigba and **22.44** from Lamar Jackson and still lost, with Matthew Stafford's **22.90** sitting on the bench. He is **0-3** with **308.36** points scored and **362.92** allowed, the most in the league. Three teams with wins have scored less than he has. He also holds the longest losing streak on record, nine, set in 2021 under a different name.

Bird Gang beat the Skidmarks **129.26 to 101.54**, which is now what happens. Jared Goff **21.36**, Kenneth Walker **19.30**, Brock Bowers **17.60**, the Jacksonville defense **16.00**, Ja'Marr Chase **15.80** — nothing spectacular and nothing below six points. Mark Mikita got **20.90** from Derrick Henry and **17.94** from Patrick Mahomes and then watched Saquon Barkley post **8.00** and Dalton Kincaid **2.80**. Bird Gang were **7-2** against the Skidmarks lifetime coming in. They are **8-2** now. In the week's other game the Jersey Devil Dogz outlasted Haven Boyz **78.02 to 68.04**, the only matchup all week that did not reach **150** combined.

**Silver Stars and Jersey Devil Dogz are 3-0** and have almost nothing in common. Justin Silver leads the league with **431.24** points, **71.56** clear of anyone else, and has no championships in twelve seasons. Chubby Ryan has **271.36** points, eighth in a ten-team league, six championships, and none since 2016. Behind them Bird Gang, the Skidmarks and the Kahunas are all **2-1**; Dirty South, Haven Boyz and the Mafia are **1-2**; Brendawg21 and Sponge Bobs are **0-3**. Six of ten make the playoffs, eleven games remain, and nobody has a magic number under **10**. Nothing is decided. Sponge Bobs and Brendawg21 are simply further from deciding it than everyone else.

posts.title: Seventeen and Out
posts.author: Commissioner
body: The streak is over. **Silver Stars 110.72, Bird Gang 107.78** — a margin of **2.94** — and the longest winning run in the history of this league stops at **17**. Josh Allen went for **43.82** and that was the whole ballgame. Jared Goff answered with **33.78** for John Ryan Jr and it was not enough. Bird Gang had not lost a football game since the 2024 season. They have now.

The week's only real beating was **ShenHgts Skidmarks 129.56 over Brendawg21, 89**. Dak Prescott put up **33.76**, Davante Adams added **31.5**, and Brandon Aubrey kicked in **17** from the kicker slot. Brendan Ryan got **33.5** out of Jaxon Smith-Njigba and produced nothing else worth naming. Dilly Dilly is **0-2**.

The Mexican Mafia beat Dirty South **100.42 to 99.1**. One and a third points. That drops Erik Marnell — seven championships, the most wins in league history — to **0-2**. The Jersey Devil Dogz handled Sponge Bobs **94.14 to 79.68** behind Amon-Ra St. Brown's **26.2**, and Ron Wasilewski left Brock Purdy and **30.48** on his bench, which is its own kind of answer.

BIG Kahunas beat Haven Boyz **75.46 to 59.62**, the two worst scores of the week arriving in the same game. Jalen Hurts managed **18.16** and it was plenty. Zack Chowansky got **25.2** out of Jonathan Taylor, which was **42%** of everything Haven Boyz scored, and **7.72** from his quarterback.

**Silver Stars, ShenHgts Skidmarks and Jersey Devil Dogz are 2-0.** Justin Silver leads the Pick and the league on points with **304.68**, seventy-four clear of anyone else. Chubby Ryan leads the Shovel at **2-0** with **193.34**, fewer points than three teams with worse records, which is more or less how a man collects six titles. Bird Gang, BIG Kahunas, Haven Boyz and Mexican Mafia sit **1-1**. Dirty South, Sponge Bobs and Dilly Dilly are **0-2**, and between them they own **eleven championships**.

One housekeeping note for the record book: Bird Gang's winning streak, which the book carried at **16 and active** all offseason, is now closed at **17**. It is still the longest in league history by seven games.

posts.title: The Box Score That Broke the Book
posts.author: Commissioner
body: **Silver Stars 193.96.** That is the most points any team has scored in a single game in the twenty-seven-year history of this league, and it is not a near thing. The old mark was Bird Gang's **170** from 2021. Justin Silver cleared it by nearly twenty-four. Every starter he put on the field scored: Josh Allen **37.66**, D'Andre Swift **31.4**, Jahmyr Gibbs **29.6**, Ashton Jeanty **26.7**, Isaiah Likely **19.8**, Evan McPherson **19** from the kicker slot. The lowest man on the card was Garrett Wilson at **7.9**.

The BIG Kahunas scored **133.62** and lost by **60.34**. Jalen Hurts went **27.72**, David Montgomery **25.9**, Bijan Robinson **23.3**, and none of it mattered. In almost any other week of almost any other season that is a comfortable win. Kyle Ryan instead takes the *Most Points Allowed — Game* record outright and now appears on that board twice.

**Bird Gang 122.64, Brendawg21 112.86** — win number seventeen in a row for John Ryan Jr, counting back through the whole of 2025. Kenneth Walker put up **31.1** and Zay Flowers **21**. Ja'Marr Chase contributed **1.2**, and Trevor Lawrence scored **30.1** sitting on the bench, which is the sort of week a team survives only when it is not losing any of them. Brendan Ryan got **26.96** from Lamar Jackson and lost anyway.

**Haven Boyz 122.26, Mexican Mafia 76.12** was the other lopsided result, built on Caleb Williams' **39.26** and Jonathan Taylor's **23.1**. The **Jersey Devil Dogz beat Dirty South 99.2 to 75.16**, a thin opening day for a man with seven championships. And the **ShenHgts Skidmarks edged Sponge Bobs 97.6 to 94.26**, with Derrick Henry going **34.3** to cover a **16.4** from Dak Prescott.
Two all-time records fell in one afternoon and both of them came out of the same box score. The previous high had stood since 2021. This one is going to sit there a while.

posts.title: Two Men, Thirteen Trophies
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Twenty-seven seasons. Twenty-seven trophies. **Erik Marnell has seven of them and Chubby Ryan has six.** That is 48% of every championship this league has ever handed out, won by two of the sixteen-odd people who have played in it.

Their methods could not be less alike. Chubby front-loaded his: **three straight from 2003 to 2005**, then three more in a four-year window from 2013 to 2016. He has not won since. Erik took his time — nothing until 2010, then **2010, 2011, 2012, 2017, 2020, 2022 and 2024**, a title roughly every other year for fifteen years, the most recent one two seasons ago.

Erik also owns three toilet bowls, which is the tell. Dirty South is 195-167-5 lifetime, the most wins in league history, and he still finds a way to bottom out every so often. Chubby has two. Nobody wins seven without occasionally losing badly.

The active chase: **Ron Wasilewski has four** and won as recently as 2021. **John Ryan Jr has three** — 2015, 2023, 2025 — and is the only man to win two of the last three. **Mark Mikita has 191 career wins, second-most all time, and exactly one title**, back in 2007 as the Purple Helmets. He also has four toilet bowls, tied with Kyle Ryan for the most anyone has taken. Twenty-five years, one ring, and the strangest résumé on the board.

posts.title: Fourteen and Oh
posts.author: Commissioner
body: There is no asterisk. **Bird Gang went 14-0**, took the first-round bye, won in week 16, and closed it out 108.18 to 79.96 over the ShenHgts Skidmarks. Sixteen games, sixteen wins, one trophy — and the only 100% regular season in twenty-seven years of this league.

The scary part is that it never really looked close. Bird Gang put up **1,585.54 points, the most any team has ever scored in a season**, breaking Dirty South's 1,576 from 2022. They also allowed the fewest points in the league that year, by a margin of 39.

It came within a quarter of a point of being ordinary. **Week 8 against the Jersey Devil Dogz finished 110.32 to 110.08** — a 0.24 margin. Flip one late catch and the whole thing is just a very good 13-1 season nobody writes about.

For the Skidmarks, second place extended one of the odder résumés in the league. Mark Mikita has **191 career wins, second-most of anyone**, and exactly one championship — 2007, back when the team was the Purple Helmets. He also has four toilet bowls, tied for the most. Twenty-five years in, that is a lot of football for one ring.

posts.title: Three of the Five Worst Days in League History
posts.author: Commissioner
body: The *Most Points Allowed — Game* table has five entries. **The Silver Stars are on it three times.**

First came 2021, when they gave up **170** — still the most points any team has surrendered in a single game in twenty-seven years. Then 2025 happened. In **week 16 the Mexican Mafia hung 163.00 on them, and in week 17, 165.14.** Back to back, same opponent, 328.14 points across fourteen days.
Both of those were consolation games. Neither decided anything.

The Mafia went 4-10 that year and are **75-91-3 lifetime**, and yet those two weeks are the highest-scoring games of the Sleeper era — fourth and fifth all time, behind Bird Gang's 170 in 2021 and Big Kahunas' 169 in 2019. It is not the first time the arithmetic has failed Alberto Ruiz. In **2021 the Mafia went 12-2**, matched since only by Dirty South in 2024 and beaten only by Bird Gang's perfect 2025 — and he did not win the title. Twelve seasons in: two toilet bowls, no rings.

The genre is well populated. **Silver Stars led the entire league in scoring in 2023** with 1,491.52 points and lost in the first round, 84.64 to 90.26. **Sponge Bobs scored the second-most points in the league in 2024** and went 7-7. Schedule luck is real and this league is the proof.

posts.title: Silver Stars Find the Floor
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Three weeks ago the Silver Stars put up **193.96**, the most points anyone has scored in a game in twenty-seven years of this league. On Sunday they managed **65.42**. That is a swing of **128.54** points in three weeks, and it was enough to lose to the ShenHgts Skidmarks **88.20** in a game neither team should want on film. Josh Allen led the Silver Stars with **19.52**. Kyle Monangai scored **27.0** on their bench, more than any Silver Stars starter, which is the sort of detail Justin will be hearing about in November. The Skidmarks did not play well either and did not need to. They are **3-1**.

The BIG Kahunas took Bird Gang **121.42-109.28** behind twin **26.7** games from Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams, and Spencer Shrader adding **16** from the kicker spot. Kenneth Walker went for **29.9** for Bird Gang, the second-highest starter score of the week, and it bought nothing. Bird Gang also left Jared Goff and his **21.48** on the bench to start Trevor Lawrence at **14.08**, which decided the game on its own. The defending champions are **2-2**. The Kahunas, who have never won anything, are **3-1**.

Mexican Mafia beat the Sponge Bobs **120.86-83.42** on two players: Tetairoa McMillan at **31.2** and Drake Maye at **30.16** combined for **61.36**, slightly more than half the roster's output. Dirty South posted the week's high at **125.42** to put away Haven Boyz **102.06**, with Joe Burrow, CeeDee Lamb and Nico Collins supplying **72.82** between them. Dirty South opened **0-2** and has now won two straight. Haven Boyz are **1-3** and started Rashee Rice for a zero.

Jersey Devil Dogz are the last unbeaten at **4-0** after handling Brendawg21 **102.38-84.68**. They have done it on **373.74** points, eighth-most in the league, which means Chubby has won four games without ever needing to be good. The franchise has six titles and none since 2016. Brendawg21, meanwhile, has scored **393.04** points — more than the unbeaten team — and sits **0-4**. The longest losing streak on record in this league is nine, set by this same franchise in 2021 under a different name. Four is not nine. It is a start.

Six of ten make the playoffs in week 15, so the standings are still mostly decoration, but the shape is there. Jersey Devil Dogz alone at **4-0**; Silver Stars, BIG Kahunas and ShenHgts Skidmarks at **3-1**; Bird Gang, Dirty South and Mexican Mafia at **2-2**; Haven Boyz at **1-3**; Brendawg21 and the Sponge Bobs at **0-4**. Ron's four-time champions have not won a game. The Silver Stars still lead the league in scoring at **496.66**, a pace that works out to roughly **1,738** over fourteen games, which would clear Bird Gang's record **1,585.54** from last season. Pace in week 4 is worth nothing. It is still there.

League-wide this was the quietest week of the year: **1,003.14** total points, an average of **100.31**, and a high score of **125.42** that is the lowest weekly high of the season. Nothing in the record book moved, and nothing came close. Ten teams, four games each, and the only franchise that has looked like itself is the one that scored 194 and then forgot how.
